newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda's group profit to triple in 96/97 - paper.
newsitem.headline: Honda's group profit to triple in 96/97 - paper.

text.p: Honda Motor Co's group net profit for the year ending on March 31 is expected to more than triple from a year ago to about 220 billion yen, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said over the weekend.
The company's earnings were expected to be buoyed by brisk sales in Japan and increased income from exports due to the weaker yen, the paper reported on Saturday.
The prior record for Honda's group net profit was 146.5 billion yen, recorded in the year ended in February 1986.
It has since changed its fiscal year.
Honda will probably sell nearly 800,000 cars in Japan in the current business year, compared with an initial forecast of 760,000 cars, the paper said.
The company's overseas sales are also likely to exceed its initial plan of 1.42 million cars, the paper said.
The weaker yen is expected to boost the group's operating profit for the current business year by more than 15 billion yen, the paper said.
A Honda spokesman was not immediately available on Monday morning to comment on the report.
